description: Round 7's own new 'Correction (2026-07-08, contract-review round-6 FIND-010)' section in contracts/sprint-2.md makes a factual claim about the contract's own 'Files touched' section that does not hold up under direct verification. The correction's closing sentence reads: "'Files touched' (below) already lists `spawn-orchestrator.mjs`/its test file, which cover both the code and the tests this correction documents -- no additional file was touched." Two problems: (1) directional -- the actual 'Files touched' section is ABOVE this correction paragraph (contract lines 108-124), not 'below' it (a minor slip, but it means the claim was not written by someone re-reading the section it references); (2) substantively -- the enumerated 'Files touched' list (contract:117-119) names exactly ONE test file for this module, `spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs` (plus `gen-solana-wallet.test.mjs`, unrelated). It does NOT name `skills/self/spawn/lib/__tests__/spawn-orchestrator-reclaim-and-shelter-cost.test.mjs` -- confirmed present on disk (17KB) -- which is the file that actually contains ALL of the dedicated FIND-001 reclaim tests: the 5 `defaultReclaimSeed`-unit-level tests (happy path, 600-perm temp file, exit-1 failure, exit-2/PENDING failure, no-tx-hash failure) plus the 7 wiring tests round 6 itself directly cited by name ('FIND-001(a)', 'FIND-001(b)', 'FIND-001(c)', 'FIND-001(c) variant', the buildChildSpec-throw case, and the mcp.json-write-failure case) -- i.e. exactly the tests round 6's own edge_case_coverage PASS evidence was based on. `spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs` (the ONLY test file the 'Files touched' section actually names) contains just one incidental reclaim-field assertion (`assertMinimalFailedRow(rows[0], 6, ["lease_id","reclaimed","reclaimTxHash"])`, line 257) -- not the dedicated suite. The reclaim test file IS mentioned once elsewhere in this same contract (line 224, as a 'Proof:' citation for the EARLIER FIND-002/PROP-303c correction, a different round's fix) -- so it is not wholly absent from the document -- but it is genuinely absent from the specific 'Files touched' enumeration this round's new sentence claims 'already lists... its test file'. This is the same class of gap FIND-010 itself named ('the contract's own "Files touched" section... was never updated to mention this new function pair') -- round 7 asserts this is now satisfied by an EXISTING list, but that existing list was never actually updated to include the file that carries the dedicated test evidence for the very mechanism this correction documents.

evidence.lineRange: 108-124 (Files touched list, only names spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs/gen-solana-wallet.test.mjs), 246-247 (round-7 correction's claim), 224 (the one, unrelated-round citation of the reclaim test file)
evidence.snippet: grep -n 'reclaim-and-shelter-cost' contracts/sprint-2.md -> only line 224 (FIND-002/PROP-303c 'Proof:' citation, an earlier round's correction), zero hits inside the 108-124 'Files touched' block itself. ls skills/self/spawn/lib/__tests__/ confirms spawn-orchestrator-reclaim-and-shelter-cost.test.mjs exists (17K) as a file SEPARATE from spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs (24K); grep -c 'reclaim' on each: reclaim-and-shelter-cost.test.mjs=47 hits (7 dedicated FIND-001 tests by name), spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs=9 hits (1 incidental field assertion, no FIND-001-named test)
